window_note: Window is 2026-10-23 amc (RCBC) plus 2026-10-26 bmo (12 names). Cheap sweep: one or two lookups per name, mostly company releases relayed by wires; edge pointers and positioning are deliberately thin.

names.why: River City Bank's own announcement: results for the quarter ended 2026-09-30 after the market closes Friday 2026-10-23; webcast Monday 2026-10-26 at 2:00 p.m. ET.
names.session_evidence: Release: results 'after the stock market closes on Friday, October 23, 2026'; call 11:00 PT / 2:00 ET on 2026-10-26 (https://finviz.com/news/400975/river-city-bank-announces-date-for-third-quarter-2026-earnings-release-and-webcast). Reaction lands in the 2026-10-26 session.
where_to_look: Recently listed bank (no prior-year EPS on the calendar, files with FDIC not the SEC as a bank-level issuer): check the FDIC call report (Q3 call report lands later, but Q2 call report details CRE concentration and deposit mix) for what the release will show
Sacramento-area CRE / construction exposure and deposit costs; Q2 EPS $1.37 vs $1.29 consensus now
Thin coverage (3-4 analysts): the bar is soft, so check buyback / dividend announcements in the release

names.session_evidence: Release: results before the market opens, call 10:00 a.m. Eastern on 2026-10-26 (https://finviz.com/news/401138/alliance-resource-partners-lp-schedules-third-quarter-2026-earnings-conference-call; PDF https://s202.q4cdn.com/937149565/files/doc_news/Alliance-Resource-Partners-L-P--Schedules-Third-Quarter-2026-Earnings-Conference-Call-2026.pdf).

Coal shipment volumes: EIA weekly/quarterly coal production by basin (Illinois Basin, Appalachia) and MSHA mine data for ARLP mines
Utility customer burn and inventory (EIA electric power monthly), export prices; oil & gas royalty segment volumes
2027 contracted tonnage and pricing commitments in the release

names.session_evidence: Only the call time (11:00 a.m. ET, 2026-10-26) is confirmed (https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/DEA/2610056959); the release hour was not stated in what I saw. A same-morning 11:00 call implies the release is pre-market Monday or after Friday's close -- the hunter must settle it from the release text or the prior-quarter 8-K acceptance time.
where_to_look: GSA lease renewals/expirations and federal-agency space consolidation (GSA lease inventory, federal 'return to office' / footprint-reduction directives)
Federal budget / shutdown risk to rent collections; Core FFO guide revisions
Dividend level after any prior cut; acquisition/JV funding
